items.name: Pickering Side Events 2023
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Pickering Side Events 2023 Cubing on the Canada Day long weekend! As we celebrate our country and communities, Canada Day is also an important opportunity to reflect on the historical and ongoing colonization and erasure of Indigenous Peoples on the lands we now call Canada. This competition will be held on the Treaty and traditional territory of the Mississaugas of Scugog Island First Nation and Williams Treaties signatories of the Mississauga and Chippewa Nations. All proceeds from this competition will be donated to the [Indian Residential School Survivors Society](https://www.irsss.ca) and [Woodland Cultural Centre](https://woodlandculturalcentre.ca). ## Side Events This competition has "side events", which does _not_ include the standard 3x3x3 Cube event. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada&show_registration_status=on) if this competition is not suitable for you. ## Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ## Mailing List We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
